title: nabalus barbatus
intro: Nabalus barbatus, commonly known as American burdock thistle or black sage, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. The plant has been utilized in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties. Its therapeutic actions include reducing fever, alleviating digestive issues, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Nabalus barbatus include sesquiterpene lactones, triterpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
